omar: Heads-up — planned rolling rack reboots in us-east2 this Saturday 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do interleaved node reboots + egress reroute to keep hosted pools healthy. Putting this thread as the coordination point. cc @mike-oncall @jen

ops-bot: maintenance-scheduler created maintenance event maint-178999 for 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying owners.

jen: quick q — which rack is the canary? and how aggressive is the cadence? :eyes: 

omar: Canary is rack-17. Cadence: conservative, interleave across racks so we never drain >10% capacity of a pool at once. Planned timeline (high level):

```
02:00-02:15 UTC — rack-17 canary: drain 1 node, reboot, healthcheck (10m)
02:15-03:30 UTC — rolling interleaved reboots across racks [rack-17,rack-21,rack-04,rack-09] with 5min spacing between node reboots within a rack
03:30-03:55 UTC — backfill & kv-cache warmseed + smoke tests
03:55-04:00 UTC — revert temporary routing and close event
```

Commands (for runbook snippet):
```
# drain example
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=600s
# post-reboot healthcheck
./scripts/node-healthcheck.sh $NODE || ./playbooks/rollback-node.sh $NODE
```

jen: added canary and timeline to the calendar invite and pinged product for a short tenant comms blurb. Draft: "We will perform brief maintenance in US-East region. Some requests may be routed to fallback region for a short period; no persistent data loss expected." Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/maintenance-template

kevin: We should pre-seed KV cache for core hosted models before the canary finishes. If we don't, token latencies spike on first requests. I'll drop a small job to warm top-20 prefixes. Script: `tools/kvseed/warm_top_prefixes.sh --top 20 --parallel 4`

dana: Cost note — if we backfill with spot instances during the window, expect ~6-8% unit-cost increase for the batch. Option: reserve short-term dedicated burst capacity from Dedicated pool (higher $/hr but lower tail-risk). Recommend ops decide by EOD Fri.

mike-oncall: I'll be oncall and available for the whole window. Ping me 30m before start and again at canary finish. I'll take ownership of rollback if we see >5% error spike or SLO breach.

omar: Final checklist I'm tracking: create rollback playbook (link), reserve burst capacity, schedule routing policy change (egress weight shift), kvcache warmseed job, telemetry alert thresholds (latency + error rate), and postmortem stub. Will publish the full runbook tomorrow morning.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll handle tenant comms & publishing the runbook link to #support once you post it.

kevin: :eyes: I'll queue the kvseed and monitor token p99 during canary. If anything looks odd I'll abort and notify.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — maint-178999 24h reminder sent to owners.
